name: io.github.mingyan9989/kaucim-public-mcp
title: Kaucim
description: BaZi and Zi Wei charts, Chinese almanac, auspicious dates and fortune sticks from a calendar engine.

tools.name: cast_bazi_chart
tools.description: Cast a BaZi (Four Pillars, 八字) chart from a birth date, local clock time and IANA time zone. Returns each pillar's stem, branch, elements, ten god, hidden stems, na yin, twelve life stages, void branches and symbolic stars; the 胎元, 命宮 and 身宮; the 節 instants either side of the birth; and ten luck pillars. Computed by Kaucim's calendar engine, so the same birth always returns the same chart. Use it instead of deriving pillars yourself. Leave time out when unknown: the hour pillar is then omitted and any other pillar that could change is listed.

date.description: Birth date as YYYY-MM-DD. Gregorian unless calendar is lunar.

lunar_leap_month.description: Lunar dates only: the month is a leap month (閏月).

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, HH:MM, 24-hour. Omit or null when unknown. Never guess it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Hong_Kong, Asia/Taipei, America/New_York.

gender.description: Sets the direction of the luck pillars.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees, east positive. Needed for true solar time.

use_true_solar_time.description: Convert the clock time to apparent solar time at the given longitude before casting.

utc_offset_minutes.description: Only to settle a clock time that occurred twice at a daylight-saving change; the error lists the two values.

late_zi.description: Births from 23:00 to 23:59. same_day (Kaucim default) keeps that date's day pillar; next_day starts the next day's pillar at 23:00, as many calculators do.

hemisphere.description: Kaucim never reverses the month pillar. With south, the result also lists the reversed month pillar some schools use.

locale.description: Language of the text summary and labels: zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese, default) or en. Machine fields carry both.

tools.name: get_bazi_strength
tools.description: Judge the Day Master's strength and the favourable and unfavourable elements (喜用神) for a birth by Kaucim's published support-and-restrain scoring (fuyi-v1). Returns strong, weak or balanced, the support ratio, every scored slot with its weight, the ranked favourable elements and a seasonal (調候) hint. The weights and thresholds are in the result. It does not judge follow (從) or transformation structures.

tools.name: cast_ziwei_chart
tools.description: Lay out a Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數) chart: the twelve palaces with their major and minor stars and brightness, the birth-year transformations (四化), the Life and Body Palaces, the five-element class and each palace's ten-year range. Same birth input as cast_bazi_chart.

tools.name: get_almanac
tools.description: Read the Chinese almanac (通勝, 黃曆) for 1 to 31 consecutive days: lunar date, year, month and day pillars, any solar term with its local time, the activities listed as suitable (宜) and to avoid (忌) with English glosses, the day's clash, the twelve officers, the day god and the auspicious double hours. No birth data needed.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in timezone.

timezone.description: IANA zone used for 'today' and for the local time of any solar term.

tools.name: find_auspicious_days
tools.description: Find days in a date range that the almanac marks suitable for a wedding, moving home or opening a business, graded good, fair or caution. Give up to four people's births to grade each day against their day pillars and zodiac branches; a clash with anyone marks the day caution. Defaults to the next three months.

activity.description: wedding (嫁娶), moving (入宅/移徙) or opening (開市).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Hong Kong.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to three months after start.

people.description: Up to four people taking part (for example both partners). Each day is graded against all of them; a clash with anyone marks it caution.

tools.name: draw_fortune_stick
tools.description: Draw a temple fortune stick (求籤) at random, or read one the person already holds, from Wong Tai Sin (黃大仙), Che Kung (車公), Guan Yin (觀音), Sixty Jiazi (六十甲子) or Guan Di (關帝). Returns the verse, its grade, the published explanation, the free reading for the question type and the stick's page. Draw once per question.

oracle.description: wong_tai_sin (黃大仙, 100 sticks), che_kung (車公), guan_yin (觀音), liushi_jiazi (六十甲子), guan_di (關帝).

sign_number.description: A stick the person already holds. Omit to draw one at random; draw once per question and do not redraw for a better stick.

question_type.description: What the question is about: career, wealth, love, health, study, home or general.

lang.description: Wong Tai Sin is published in zh, en and th; the other sets in Chinese only.

tools.name: get_reference_sources
tools.description: Read the current public reference index: canonical source links, available languages, citation scope, limits and dataset versions. It does not fetch each linked page.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Read current public products, supported languages, routes, pricing sources and availability. Preserve the catalog review dates and limits when citing it.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one published Chinese, English, Thai or Japanese article as Markdown. Use a known article slug from the site. An unknown slug returns an error.

tools.name: get_wong_tai_sin_stick
tools.description: Look up an existing Wong Tai Sin stick number from 1 to 100. Returns the published reference and reading in Chinese or English. Does not draw a random stick or create a personalised reading.
